steps.name: Sui
steps.text: ...Traitors.

steps.name: Sui
steps.text: You twelve, each and every one of you, plan to betray me, yes?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Indeed. None of us will submit to becoming a part of you.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: We have lived as ourselves. This is why we are different from you.

steps.name: Sui
steps.text: Lived as... humans?

steps.name: Sui
steps.text: You see yourselves as human, and try to bring delusions varied to bear against me.

steps.name: Sui
steps.text: You relied on the power you stole from me, ingratiating yourselves with those puny insects, but you still had to humble yourselves, hiding your claws and fangs to make yourselves look harmless.

steps.name: Sui
steps.text: Is that what you mean by living as a human?!

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: You still do not understand... You can never understand, for you have never lived.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: And I am well-aware... from where your arrogance stems.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: With but a glance, you can look from the beginning of time to its end. Though your consciousness has traversed the great void for eons, you have never had kin you could converse with.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: You are simply a god declaring Itself supreme over a pitiful plot of empty space.
I know full well what this feeling was like.
Until the day someone gave me a name.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: You are nobody's fate... Not the people of this land, or we twelve.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: And there is one thing you will never understand: against someone who already has nothing to his name...

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: ...Fate is utterly powerless.

steps.name: Sui
steps.text: Very well... Since you dare to repeat your foolish challenge, I do not mind shattering your delusions once more.

steps.name: Sui
steps.text: I killed you once a hundred-and-twenty years ago! I shall kill you again with but a flick of my wrist!

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Is that meant to scare me?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I am already accustomed to losing.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I have already lost too many precious, precious things. I have lost the entire board.
My dignity, my honor, my trust, my freedom, myself.
My family.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Did you really think someone with nothing more to lose would be afraid?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: But you?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Are you not afraid you will suffer another ignominious defeat, like a thousand years ago?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Is this fear not what makes you hesitate to step forward?

steps.name: Sui
steps.text: ...A jest, at this hour!

steps.name: Sui
steps.text: You desire in vain to replace me, to steal away my body. Why would I allow you to do as you please?!

steps.name: Sui
steps.text: I need only stir this body awake first—
The Feranmut extends Its talons, talons as great as mountains.
Countless Feranmuts in countless Tombs extend Their talons, countless talons as great as mountains, and point them towards the same proxy.
It does not matter if this is a dream. So long as that loathsome face is wiped away in all of them, there will be nothing left to stop Its awakening.

steps.name: Sui
steps.text: What is this...
An incomparably brutal blow slams into Its body. A strength It is familiar with.
It knows, that in this split-second, It has lost Its connection with Its enormous body.
Who could cause such harm to Its form?!
The space shakes, then warps, and tears...
As if a thousand years worth of martial prowess has been channeled into a single strike, ripping apart the edges of the dream.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Why are you—

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Always so meddlesome!

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I knew you would say that.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I also promised that, were things to arrive at this stage, I will be with you.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Besides, I also wanted to bring her to meet you, to let you know that all your years of planning... were not for naught.
Through the boundary between dream and reality, Wang sees the token Chongyue clutches to his bosom...
And then, their eyes meet.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: You should leave...

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Live.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Live, and come back to us.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I will not make you any promises.
The distance between them stretches with speed.
Even though he is a Grandmaster of kung fu, a thousand years old, a human body is still only a human body.
The force piercing the veil between truth and fiction quickly dissipates, but the voice of that brother Wang is so fed up with still reaches his ears.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Then I will look for you. I always will.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Suit yourself.

steps.name: Sui
steps.text: What did he... What did he do?!

steps.name: Sui
steps.text: But it does not matter! IT DOES NOT MATTER! No matter what he did, it was only for an instant... AN INSTANT!

steps.name: Sui
steps.text: No longer shall he disturb us! Nor will any of your ludicrous, insignificant... siblings!

spans.text: No longer shall he disturb us! Nor will any of your ludicrous, insignificant...

steps.name: Sui
steps.text: This is my dream, with only you and I!

steps.name: Sui
steps.text: I thought I would have to bring all my strength to bear to defeat you, but it seems you are still weak, still liable to collapse at the slightest of breezes. You only have a single stone left...

steps.name: Sui
steps.text: I will barely even have to lift my finger... to crush you! To annihilate you!

steps.name: Sui
steps.text: And those poems, those laws, those martial arts... Such irksome pests. I need only use the strength I saved for you to isolate you from those meddlesome insects!

steps.name: Sui
steps.text: You are unfit to die by my claws. You are only fit to be cut down by your reflection's blade... Now DIE!

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Hah... Is that so?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: To die is your end, not mine.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Yes. In all these causal chains, in all these possibilities, in all these dreams, you will die.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: These countless repetitions within this dream have eroded away, hollowed out your most frenzied imaginings. And all without you knowing.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Have you not noticed how intricately linked you and I are to this dream you used to trap me?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: You have been chained by your hateful, vengeful impulses... Your evolution has reached its end.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: And we have already surpassed you.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: But your body will persist.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I... will take your place.

steps.name: Sui
steps.text: And how will you do that? With your isolated stones, and with your own body, so ready to fall apart?!

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: You dare assume... I only have my stones... and this body of mine?!
The near-dead proxy uses the last of his strength to lift his sword.
The deranged Feranmut gives one last howl of rage.

a.text: The cold moons split stones; the fierce sun chars boards...

spans.text: The cold moons split stones; the fierce sun chars boards...

a.text: Ashes to ashes, a farewell to the ages.

spans.text: Ashes to ashes, a farewell to the ages.
